execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "extraction_runtime"

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."artifactReference" (
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "generation" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."attempt" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "failure" jsonb,
  "fence" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "outcome" text,
  "selectionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "workflowId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."capture" (
  "candidates" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "descriptor" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "feedbackVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "generation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "inFlight" bool NOT NULL,
  "invoked" bool NOT NULL,
  "originalAttemptId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "reservationAttemptId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "reservationEpoch" int4 NOT NULL,
  "selectionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "unitKey" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."checkpoint" (
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "inputDigest" text NOT NULL,
  "output" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "outputDigest" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."command" (
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "response" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."correction" (
  "candidate" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decision" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "feedbackVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "included" bool NOT NULL,
  "projectId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "revision" int4 NOT NULL,
  "selectionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "snapshotVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "valueId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."dispatch" (
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "received" bool NOT NULL,
  "workflowId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."effective" (
  "configuration" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."feedbackHead" (
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."finalization" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "decisionDigest" text NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "feedbackVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "snapshotVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."head" (
  "acknowledgement" text NOT NULL,
  "attemptId" "uuid",
  "controlVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "deleted" bool NOT NULL,
  "fence" int4 NOT NULL,
  "generation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "intent" text NOT NULL,
  "leaseEpoch" int4 NOT NULL,
  "leaseOwner" "uuid",
  "leaseUntil" timestamptz(6),
  "pendingResume" bool NOT NULL,
  "pendingSelectionId" "uuid",
  "projectId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "selectionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "snapshotVersion" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sourcePin" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "sourceRevisionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "strategy" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."input" (
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "request" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."plan" (
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "generation" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "manifest" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "stage" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."protocol" (
  "id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."selection" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "method" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "ordinal" int4 NOT NULL,
  "resolved" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "schemaHash" text NOT NULL,
  "schemaRevisionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "schemaTree" jsonb NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "extraction_runtime"."snapshot" (
  "coverage" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "digest" text NOT NULL,
  "extractionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "selectionId" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "values" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
